# workflows

CI workflows.

| Workflow | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`pages.yml`](pages.yml) | Builds the introduction pages in [`site/`](../../site/README.md) in both languages, and the pages of the language standard with [`scripts/spec/`](../../scripts/spec/README.md). On pull requests that touch `site/`, `spec/` or `scripts/spec/` it only checks the build, which fails when a text lacks one of its languages or a check of the standard fails; on `main` it also publishes the pages to GitHub Pages. It runs on `main` again after `spec-release.yml` succeeds, so that the pages of the standard carry the new revision label; only `main` may deploy to the `github-pages` environment. Pages must use "GitHub Actions" as its source. |
| [`spec-release.yml`](spec-release.yml) | On a tag such as `spec-0.2-r1`, builds every form of the standard and attaches them to the GitHub release "RNL 0.2, revision 1"; the tag's message becomes the release notes ([decision 0007](../../docs/decisions/0007-publishing-the-standard.md)). |
| [`desktop.yml`](desktop.yml) | Checks formatting, runs clippy and the tests of the desktop viewer in [`apps/desktop`](../../apps/desktop/README.md) on Linux, Windows and macOS, with the web fonts of the page it embeds written by [`scripts/fonts.py`](../../scripts/README.md), and checks every script of the page, [`apps/viewer-ui`](../../apps/viewer-ui/README.md). On Windows it also runs the app's smoke test, which drives it through WebView2's DevTools port. Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the viewer, its page, the crates, the standard library, the font script or the netlist the smoke test opens. |
| [`viewer.yml`](viewer.yml) | Tests the viewers' shared page in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with Playwright, against a fake shell, and smoke-tests the web viewer's site with the core as WebAssembly ([`tests/viewer`](../../tests/viewer/README.md)), on Linux; installs Rust with the WebAssembly target and the browsers with what they need, and keeps the report of a failed run. Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the page, the web viewer, the bindings, the tests, the conformance corpus, the crates or the standard library. |
| [`rust.yml`](rust.yml) | Checks formatting, runs clippy and the tests of the Rust workspace on Linux, Windows and macOS. On Linux it also builds the core crates and the WebAssembly binding in [`bindings/runtime-wasm`](../../bindings/runtime-wasm/README.md), tests the binding's JavaScript modules, and requires that native and WebAssembly builds give identical Documents on the conformance corpus and the standard packages; and it downloads the pinned fonts and requires that the renderer's font metrics are what they give (`python scripts/fonts.py metrics --check`). Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the crates, the bindings, the standard library, the test corpora or the font script; changes to the page's tests in `tests/viewer` alone are left to `viewer.yml`. |
| [`web.yml`](web.yml) | Builds the web viewer in [`apps/web`](../../apps/web/README.md) on Linux: the web fonts with [`scripts/fonts.py`](../../scripts/README.md), the core as WebAssembly and the site with the samples; checks every script of the site with `node --check`, and that the site is served with the MIME types a browser needs. Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the web viewer, the page, the bindings, the crates, the standard library, the font script or the conformance corpus, which gives the samples. |

`pages.yml` and `spec-release.yml` install pandoc, Typst and the CJK fonts at pinned versions through the local action [`install-spec-tools`](../actions/install-spec-tools/action.yml).

See the [roadmap](../../docs/roadmap.md) for planned work.
